prompt: Create a vertical ultra-realistic fashion wedding portrait of a young East Asian bride standing on a rocky seaside shore under bright midday sunlight. She has long wavy dark brown hair, fair skin, soft natural makeup, and a gentle closed-mouth smile while leaning slightly forward toward the camera. She wears a romantic ivory tulle wedding gown with thin spaghetti straps, layered ruffled bodice, voluminous translucent skirt, a wide-brim white lace bridal hat with a sheer veil flowing down behind her, a short pearl necklace, and white elbow-length lace gloves. She holds a lush bouquet of lavender roses, small purple blossoms, tiny white wildflowers, and green stems in both gloved hands at waist level. The background shows a vivid deep-blue ocean with small waves, pale rocks at the bottom edge, a distant coastal town and low hills on the right horizon, and a bright blue sky with scattered soft white clouds. Include exactly 9 visible seagulls: 1 large gull near the upper left, 1 tiny gull below it, 1 small gull near the top center, 1 flying gull above the bride’s right shoulder, 1 large gull in the upper right, 1 small gull below it, 1 gull low over the left water, 1 gull mid-right over the water, and 1 gull near the lower right waterline. Use a dreamy airy bridal editorial style, crisp facial detail, natural skin texture, soft wind-blown hair and veil, luminous whites, high dynamic range, shallow depth of field, 9:16 composition, camera at chest height, 85mm portrait lens look, realistic proportions, no text, no watermark.
